# Background

- Microplastics are increasing in abundance in aquatic systems

- Biofilm accumulation on microplastics could have nutritional benefit

- Fluctuating food avalibility leading to starvation effect relevance

# Objectives

1.  Does aging microplastics alter how microplastics affect the physiology of a freshwater copepod

## Hypotheses

> 1.  Exposure to microplastics will decrease the thermal limits in the freshwater copepod *Skistodiaptomus pallidus.*
> 2.  The upper thermal limit for copepods exposed to aged microplastics will be higher than the upper thermal limit for those exposed to un-aged microplastics.
> 3.  Because of the nutritional content of biofilms, starved copepods with aged microplastics will exhibit a smaller decrease in thermal limit relative to the control copepods, while starved copepods with un-aged microplastics will exhibit a sharp decrease in thermal limits.
